description: payload-variant values constructed in expressions (qualified and bare callee) — a cell initializer, a cell write, a return, an argument, a nested bare payload argument — then matched, compared with == / != (unit and payload), and rendered.
rationale: §14.4: "Constructing a payload variant (`Shape.Rectangle(w, h)`, `.Circle(r)`) supplies exactly one positional argument per declared field, in declaration order", across "`let` / `const` / state-cell initializers, `return`, and `fail`"; §14.10: a constructor argument resolves against the PAYLOAD field's type; §45.2: "Payload variants compare by tag + payload fields."
